QUOTE: "**Schema and code staleness are never auto-refreshed.** ... A build through an outdated process would run old pipeline logic and re-stamp the index with it" and "For a code notice, the caller restarts the MCP client so the process loads the current code, then calls `index(action='refresh', force=True)`." and "**Data staleness is fixed automatically.**" (rebuild)
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes different remedies per axis (rebuild for data, restart for code), but never states that this is why a single flag would not have sufficed.
